title: Border Patrol Marine Unit Dog Rescue
description: Patrol Unit Agents from Laredo Texas rescuing a German Shepard from a neighborhood in Missouri, Texas. Agents were able to locate the German Shepard using GPS and an address provided to them. The German Shepard was handed over to Veterinary personnel for care and safekeeping.
keywords: Customs and Border Protection, border patrol, Hurricane Harvey, cbpharvey, K-9
unit_name: U.S. Customs and Border Protection Office of Public Affairs - Visual Communications Division
